rationale: The September 24 3.2.0 matrix row has Kubernetes 1.32–1.37 and Enterprise 10.0.12–10.6.0. The September 8 3.2.0 project changelog lists Kubernetes 1.32–1.36 and Enterprise 10.6.0. Both identify the Queue secret reference change for Index & Ingestion Separation. The Help guidance prioritizes the Operator upgrade. Neither determines an 11.x pairing.

exclusions: No Enterprise 11.x, exact Kubernetes support outside the compared ranges, Cloud availability or authorization.
